arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Deep left-facing crouch, torso almost horizontal. Tool arm extends nearly horizontally toward screen-LEFT at head height. ONE dark charcoal hammer head is outermost LEFT, with short handle continuing down-right of the gripping hand, matching the source. Free arm runs diagonally down-left to a lower empty hand. One eye looking down-left. Supporting leg under hips, other leg bent back to right. No overhead arm and no debris in this frame. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
